summary: xAI announced that Grok 4.5, previously introduced elsewhere, is now available on grok.com, X, and the Grok iOS and Android apps, alongside Microsoft 365 add-in integrations.

mechanisms.reason: Broadening the model's availability across web, X, and both major mobile platforms expands the surfaces generating inference traffic.
mechanisms.quote: Grok 4.5 now powers Grok wherever you use it , live today on grok.com , on X, and in the Grok apps for iOS and Android.

practices.reason: Teams using Grok inside Microsoft Office apps now have an add-in integration point to be aware of.
practices.quote: Grok also works directly inside Word , Excel , PowerPoint , and Outlook with our Microsoft 365 add-ins.
